comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar: partnership box 1 12,000 and box 4a 10,000 both reach Schedule E Part II (22,000, column (k) nonpassive) so total income is 70,250; box 14A 22,000 drives SE tax 3,109 = 15.3% of 92.35% (20,317, half-up), whose deductible half 1,555 sets AGI 68,695; taxable 52,945; income tax 6,558 = table(52,925 midpoint: 1,192.50 + 4,386 + 979); total tax 9,667; withholding 6,000 < tax so overpayment is 0. Item G true, item D false; no QBI (guaranteed payments are excluded by IRC 199A(c)(4)(B), and a plain box 1 earns none at this pin). Schedule SE lines 10 and 11 are each rounded to whole dollars before line 12 adds them (2,519 + 589), so the deductible half is 1,554.00 not 1,555.00: line 11 and line 15 are 1.00 above the 076 figures and line 24 is 1.00 below.
